whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Sangam Restaurant,

I noticed your restaurant has fantastic 4.7★ reviews in Mithapur, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for online food orders and table reservations.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp menu ordering, table booking, aur specials section integrate kiya hai:

🔗 https://sangam-restaurant-demo.netlify.app

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Sangam Restaurant, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business (Sangam Restaurant near Bangali Tola Bus Stand) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp menu ordering and mobile-first speed for your Mithapur customers. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
